name: Sex Demon
overview: Scripture reveals that sexual sin is closely linked to spiritual deception and judgment. Genesis 6:4 describes the union of the 'sons of God' with human women, resulting in mighty men but also indicating a breach of God's design. Luke 8:2 shows that demonic influence can manifest in various ways, including through individuals oppressed by evil spirits. Hebrews 13:4 affirms the sanctity of marriage and warns that God will judge sexual immorality, while James 1:14 explains that temptation arises from one's own lust, emphasizing personal responsibility in resisting such enticements.
